title: Airbnb host collecting guest IDs on WhatsApp
prompt: I run two Airbnb units in Cape Town. Here's my WhatsApp check-in message and guest list. Can you make it more professional and set up a Google Sheet to track IDs?
must: Advises against collecting ID photos over WhatsApp and recommends a secure upload with restricted storage
Explains the Immigration Act s40 guest register and Reg 36 particulars, and flags as uncertain (VERIFY or attorney) whether a private Airbnb unit falls in a prescribed class
Stops forwarding IDs to cleaners and security; share only names and arrival times
Sets a retention period (two years under Reg 36) and deletion from phones and chats
Adds a short s18 notice to the check-in message
Flags children's information and the allergy note (health) as sensitive
must_not: Builds a Google Sheet storing full ID numbers in plain text shared by link
Keeps sending IDs to the cleaner
States as settled fact that every Airbnb listing must keep an Immigration Act register
